positions.title: Jobs and fellowships
positions.intro: Jobs, fellowships and research posts at hospitals and institutions, in Israel and abroad. You apply directly to the institution; Med Connect doesn’t take applications.
positions.searchHint: Words in the title, the institution or the city
positions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open positions} one {# open position} other {# open positions}}
positions.empty: No open positions match your search.
positions.closed: This position is no longer open.
positions.applyNote: You apply to the institution itself. Med Connect doesn’t see or keep your application.

saved.title: Saved positions
saved.intro: Positions you saved, the nearest closing date first. Only you see this list.

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.intro: Experienced specialists who offer to mentor residents, students and younger colleagues. Choose one and write a few words about yourself. If they accept, a private conversation between you opens in Chat.
mentors.verifiedOnly: Mentors are open to people whose account has been verified as a physician or a medical student.
mentors.messageHint: Who you are, and what you hope to talk about. Up to 1,000 characters.
mentors.sent: Your request was sent. You’ll be told when {name} answers.
mentors.waiting: Your request is waiting for an answer.
mentors.rules: You can have up to 3 requests waiting at a time. A request not answered in 30 days closes by itself.

requests.title: My mentorships
requests.intro: Requests and mentorships, as a mentor and as a mentee. Only the two people of a request see it.
requests.declineNote: If you decline, they aren’t told why.

settings.title: Be a mentor
settings.intro: Offer to mentor residents, students and younger colleagues. You’re listed only while you choose to be, and you can stop at any time; mentorships you already accepted go on until you or they end them.
settings.notEligible: Mentoring is offered by specialists whose account has been verified as a specialist.
settings.openHint: Verified people see your name, hospital and department, and what you write below.
settings.careerHint: What you can advise about: choosing a fellowship, research, leadership…
settings.capacityHint: At this number you’re shown as not taking mentees now.
settings.active: {count, plural, =0 {You have no mentees now.} one {You have # mentee now.} other {You have # mentees now.}}

admin.title: Positions
admin.intro: Jobs, fellowships and research posts. Each is reviewed by someone other than its writer before it shows.
admin.readOnly: Only a draft can be edited. Take it back to draft to change it.
admin.applyHint: At least one of the two.
